data.title: Binghatti Ghost
data.about:
Binghatti Ghost at Al Jaddaf presents a remarkable collection of studio to 3-bedroom apartments, each thoughtfully designed to offer both luxury and comfort. The interiors feature elegant wood porcelain surfaces, creating a natural, earthy ambiance that blends seamlessly with the floor-to-ceiling windows. Strategically positioned along Al Khail Road, Binghatti Ghost Dubai comprises 770 residential units and six retail outlets.

The Binghatti development offers an array of amenities to enhance the lifestyle of its residents. At the podium level, a swimming pool complete with sun beds provides a tranquil retreat. The lower floor of Binghatti Ghost features retail spaces, offering residents convenient access to shops and essential services.

characteristics_module.title: Apartments With Contemporary Designs and Outstanding Connectivity
characteristics_module.heading: Unique Selling Points
characteristics_module.description:
• Prime Location: Moments away from Downtown Dubai, with easy access to Dubai Mall and Burj Khalifa, residents are offered a central and vibrant lifestyle.
  • Exceptional Connectivity: Strategically located along Al Khail Road, ensuring seamless connectivity to key areas across Dubai. The Al Jaddaf Metro Station is also easily accessible.
  • Luxurious Living Spaces: Binghatti Ghost offers studio, 2, and 3-bedroom suites with contemporary design and high-quality finishes, ensuring a modern and elegant living experience.
  • Stunning Architecture: The towers feature crystalline glass façades, complemented by lush green landscapes that create a harmonious blend of nature and modernity.
  • Impressive Amenities: Residents and guests are greeted by a luxury lobby, providing a welcoming atmosphere with attentive guest services.
  • Trusted Developer: Developed by Binghatti, a renowned name in Dubai’s real estate market known for delivering innovative and high-quality projects.
  • Community Appeal: Located in Al Jaddaf, a thriving area that offers the perfect balance of modern city living and tranquility.

location_tile.title: Everything is Within Reach for Binghatti Ghost Residents
location_tile.heading: Location
location_tile.description:
Binghatti Ghost's location in Al Jaddaf places residents within proximity to some of Dubai's most iconic landmarks and essential conveniences. Just minutes from Downtown Dubai, the development offers easy access to the world-famous Burj Khalifa and Dubai Mall, allowing residents to enjoy the city's finest shopping, dining, and entertainment experiences.

Moreover, Festival City Mall, another major retail and lifestyle destination, is just a short drive away, offering even more options for leisure and entertainment. Binghatti Ghost residences also provide seamless access to essential amenities. Residents can find reputable schools, supermarkets, and hospitals nearby, making daily life comfortable and convenient.

3 Minutes - Dubai Mall
5 Minutes - Dubai Frame
9 Minutes - Dubai International Airport (DXB)
10 Minutes - Dubai Creek Harbor
10 Minutes - Dubai Design District
10 Minutes - Meydan Racecourse

seo.metaTitle: Binghatti Ghost at Al Jaddaf Dubai
seo.metaDescription: Welcome to Binghatti Ghost residences, located at Al Jaddaf. The luxury apartments are available in studio, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom configurations.

more_info.answer: Binghatti Ghost at Al Jaddaf offers a range of luxurious amenities designed to enhance the living experience. These include a swimming pool with sun beds at the podium level, a beautifully designed lobby to welcome guests, lush green landscapes surrounding the towers, and easy access to retail outlets.
more_info.question: What are the top Binghatti Ghost at Al Jaddaf amenities?

more_info.answer: Residents of Binghatti Ghost enjoy close proximity to several major shopping destinations. Festival City Mall is just a short drive away, offering a wide range of retail, dining, and entertainment options. Additionally, the iconic Dubai Mall, one of the largest malls in the world, is only minutes away, providing residents with unparalleled access to luxury shopping and leisure activities.
